{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove refunded orders (they are not real revenue)
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print("Customer segment by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)

# Check average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Stratify by customer_segment to check for confounding
print("\nConversion rate by channel and customer_segment:")
conversion_by_strata = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
print(conversion_by_strata)

print("\nAverage revenue by channel and customer_segment:")
revenue_by_strata = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack()
print(revenue_by_strata)"}
